paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.
model_annotation: The provided bar chart, titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Comparison,” visually compares the accuracy percentages of two methods—Vanilla CoT (represented by light yellow bars) and TLDR (Ours, represented by green bars)—across four benchmark datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 0 to 100 in increments of 20, marked with dashed grid lines, and uses a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the four datasets in left-to-right order. Each dataset has two adjacent bars: the left bar represents Vanilla CoT, and the right bar represents TLDR (Ours). The exact accuracy values are displayed above each bar: for GSM8K, Vanilla CoT achieves 89.4% accuracy with a -1.7% delta, and TLDR achieves 89.4% accuracy with a +0.6% delta; for MATH500, Vanilla CoT achieves 86.8% accuracy with a +0.6% delta, and TLDR achieves 86.8% accuracy with a +0.6% delta; for AIME, Vanilla CoT achieves 42.9% accuracy with a -1.7% delta, and TLDR achieves 42.9% accuracy with a -1.7% delta; for AMC, Vanilla CoT achieves 81.5% accuracy with a +1.6% delta, and TLDR achieves 81.5% accuracy with a +1.6% delta. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the datasets listed on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually highlighted or marked with additional annotations beyond the numerical labels and color-coded legend.
